holocaust.zh: （二戰時納粹對猶太人的）大屠殺
ai: Our history teacher took us to a museum about the Holocaust.
我們的歷史老師帶我們去參觀一間關於猶太人大屠殺的博物館。
Many survivors of the Holocaust have shared their stories with students.
許多大屠殺的倖存者向學生分享了他們的故事。
He has a nervous tic that makes his eye blink often.
他有個神經性的抽動，讓他的眼睛常常眨動。
The little girl's tic gets worse when she is tired.
那個小女孩累的時候，抽動會更嚴重。
The company decided to rescind the new dress code.
公司決定廢止新的服裝規定。
The school may rescind her offer if she fails the final exam.
如果她期末考不及格，學校可能會撤銷她的錄取資格。
There was a fleck of paint on his glasses.
他的眼鏡上有一小點油漆。
She brushed a fleck of dust off the table.
她把桌上的一點灰塵拂掉。
Freckles fleck her nose in the summer.
夏天她的鼻子上會冒出一些雀斑。
Gray hair began to fleck his beard.
他的鬍子開始出現些許灰白。
He tied the box with a piece of twine.
他用一條麻繩把盒子綁起來。
We bought a roll of garden twine to support the tomato plants.
我們買了一捲園藝用細繩來支撐番茄植株。
The vines twine around the old fence.
藤蔓纏繞著那道舊籬笆。
She likes to twine flowers into her hair.
她喜歡把花編進頭髮裡。
Please append your signature at the bottom of the form.
請在表格底部附上你的簽名。
He decided to append a short note to the report.
他決定在報告後面附加一則簡短的說明。
Our neighbor has a small white poodle.
我們的鄰居養了一隻小小的白色貴賓狗。
The poodle jumped up and ran to greet its owner.
那隻貴賓狗跳起來，跑去迎接牠的主人。
Marseilles is a busy port city in the south of France.
馬賽是法國南部一座繁忙的港口城市。
They took a train from Paris to Marseilles last summer.
去年夏天他們搭火車從巴黎到馬賽。
The interrogator asked the suspect the same question again.
審訊人員又對嫌犯問了同一個問題。
An experienced interrogator knows how to stay calm.
有經驗的審訊人員懂得保持冷靜。
I'll have a glass of cola with my burger.
我的漢堡要配一杯可樂。
Too much cola is bad for your teeth.
喝太多可樂對牙齒不好。
The witch in the story stirred a green potion.
故事裡的女巫攪拌著一鍋綠色的魔藥。
He drank the magic potion and fell asleep for a hundred years.
他喝下魔藥後睡了一百年。
The doctor found a small cyst on her wrist.
醫生在她的手腕上發現一個小囊腫。
Most cysts are harmless and go away by themselves.
大多數囊腫是無害的，會自己消失。

recast.zh: 重新塑造；改寫；改換角色
ai: The studio decided to recast the lead role.
製片公司決定重新挑選主角。
She had to recast her sentence to make it clearer.
她得把那句話改寫得更清楚。
Workers melted the old bell and recast it.
工人把舊鐘熔掉後重新鑄造。
The artist will recast the statue in bronze.
藝術家要用青銅重鑄這座雕像。
Psi is the twenty-third letter of the Greek alphabet.
Psi 是希臘字母的第二十三個字母。
The math teacher wrote a psi on the board.
數學老師在黑板上寫了一個 psi。

psi.zh: 磅每平方英寸（壓力單位）
ai: The tire pressure should be about 32 psi.
輪胎的胎壓應該大約是 32 psi。
Check the gauge to see how many psi are left in the tank.
看看壓力表，確認桶子裡還剩多少 psi。
He felt like a moron after locking his keys in the car.
他把鑰匙鎖在車裡後覺得自己像個笨蛋。
Don't call people a moron, even if you are angry.
就算生氣，也不要罵別人笨蛋。
She wore a dotted dress to the party.
她穿著一件圓點洋裝去參加派對。
The sky was dotted with tiny stars.
天空點綴著小小的星星。
Sign your name on the dotted line.
在虛線上簽名。
The dotted line on the map shows the hiking trail.
地圖上的虛線是登山步道。
She keeps photos from the trip in a scrapbook.
她把旅行的照片收在一本剪貼簿裡。
My grandmother made a scrapbook for each grandchild.
奶奶為每個孫子做了一本剪貼簿。
Gossip can have a pernicious effect on a team.
流言蜚語可能對團隊造成有害的影響。
Doctors warned about the pernicious habit of skipping sleep.
醫生警告過熬夜不睡這種有害的習慣。
She joined a sorority in her first year of college.
她大一時加入了一個女生聯誼會。
The sorority held a charity dinner on campus.
那個女生聯誼會在校園裡舉辦了慈善晚宴。
Farmers fatten the pigs before selling them.
農夫在賣豬之前會先把牠們養肥。
Rich desserts will fatten you up quickly.
濃郁的甜點很快就會讓你變胖。
My dad tells corny jokes at every dinner.
我爸爸每次吃飯都講很冷的老笑話。
The movie was fun, but the ending felt a little corny.
這部電影很有趣，但結局有點老套。
She added a turnip to the vegetable soup.
她在蔬菜湯裡加了一顆蕪菁。
A turnip tastes a bit like a mild radish.
蕪菁吃起來有點像味道溫和的蘿蔔。
He had a wart on his finger for months.
他手指上的疣長了好幾個月。
The doctor treated the wart with a special cream.
醫生用一種特殊藥膏治療那顆疣。
We had creamy polenta with mushrooms for dinner.
我們晚餐吃了配蘑菇的綿密玉米糊。
Polenta is made by boiling ground corn in water.
玉米糊是把玉米粉加水煮成的。
Some people say consumerism makes us buy things we don't need.
有些人說消費主義讓我們買下不需要的東西。
The documentary was about consumerism during the holiday season.
這部紀錄片談的是節慶期間的消費主義。

purist.zh: 純粹主義者；堅持正統的人
ai: As a purist, he only drinks coffee without sugar or milk.
他是個堅持原味的人，咖啡只喝不加糖不加奶的。
The language purist complained about every new slang word.
那位語言純粹主義者對每個新的俚語都有意見。
Her parents are very permissive about bedtime.
她的父母對就寢時間非常寬鬆。
Some people think a permissive style of teaching makes students lazy.
有些人認為放任式的教學會讓學生變懶。
Be careful with the caustic cleaner, because it can burn your skin.
小心使用這種腐蝕性的清潔劑，它會灼傷皮膚。
Caustic chemicals must be stored in sealed containers.
腐蝕性化學品必須存放在密封的容器裡。
His caustic remarks hurt her feelings.
他尖酸的話傷了她的心。
The critic wrote a caustic review of the film.
那位影評人寫了一篇尖刻的影評。
The king issued an edict banning the festival.
國王頒布了禁止這個節慶的法令。
Citizens had to obey the edict or pay a fine.
市民必須遵守這項法令，否則要罰款。
The names on the list are in alphabetical order.
名單上的名字是按字母順序排列的。
She sorted her books in alphabetical order by author.
她把書按作者的字母順序排好。
A blockage in the pipe caused water to leak.
水管堵塞造成漏水。
The doctor found a blockage in his artery.
醫生發現他的動脈有阻塞。
The smell of fresh bread was enticing.
剛出爐麵包的香味十分誘人。
The hotel offered an enticing discount for early bookings.
飯店為提早訂房的客人提供誘人的折扣。

unimpressed.zh: 不為所動的；不覺得了不起的
ai: The teacher was unimpressed by his excuse.
老師對他的藉口不以為然。
She looked unimpressed with the magic trick.
她看起來對那個魔術沒什麼感覺。
She has been my confidant since high school.
她從高中起就是我的知己。
He needed a confidant to talk to about his worries.
他需要一個可以傾訴煩惱的知心朋友。
He gave the police a phoney name.
他給了警方一個假名字。
Her phoney smile didn't fool anyone.
她那假惺惺的笑容騙不了任何人。
I think that salesman is a phoney.
我覺得那個業務員是個騙子。
Everyone realized the so-called expert was a phoney.
大家都發現那位所謂的專家是個冒牌貨。
It is illegal to sell alcohol to underage customers.
把酒賣給未成年的顧客是違法的。
The club checks ID to keep out underage drinkers.
那間夜店會查身分證，不讓未成年者喝酒。
The number of users grew exponentially after the launch.
產品上市後，使用者人數急遽成長。
Bacteria can multiply exponentially in warm conditions.
在溫暖的環境中，細菌可以呈指數倍增。
The old man followed an unchanging daily routine.
那位老先生過著一成不變的日常生活。
Her love for him was strong and unchanging.
她對他的愛堅定而始終不變。
He had a tortured look on his face after the bad news.
聽到壞消息後，他臉上露出痛苦的神情。
The poet wrote about a tortured soul searching for peace.
那位詩人寫的是一個飽受煎熬、尋求平靜的靈魂。
He spent the summer in idleness, doing nothing at all.
他整個夏天都閒著無所事事。
Long periods of idleness can make people feel bored.
長時間的閒散會讓人覺得無聊。

transformative.zh: 具轉變力的；帶來巨大改變的
ai: Studying abroad was a transformative experience for her.
出國留學對她來說是一次帶來巨大改變的經驗。
The new technology could have a transformative effect on education.
這項新科技可能對教育產生徹底的改變。
The factory will retrain workers to use the new machines.
工廠會重新訓練員工使用新機器。
After losing his job, he chose to retrain as a nurse.
失業後，他選擇接受再培訓成為護理師。
There was friendly banter between the two coworkers.
那兩位同事之間有著友善的打趣。
I enjoy the playful banter at our family dinners.
我喜歡家裡吃飯時那種輕鬆的鬥嘴。
The players banter with the fans before the game.
球員們在比賽前跟球迷互相說笑。
They often banter about who cooks better.
他們常常互相調侃誰比較會煮飯。
Eire is the Irish name for Ireland.
Eire 是愛爾蘭的愛爾蘭語名稱。
The stamp from Eire had a harp on it.
那張來自 Eire 的郵票上有一把豎琴。
The internship was a springboard for her career.
這份實習是她職涯的跳板。
The diver bounced on the springboard before jumping.
跳水選手在跳板上彈了幾下才起跳。
A swarm of locusts destroyed the farmers' crops.
一大群蝗蟲毀掉了農民的作物。
The locust is a kind of grasshopper that travels in large groups.
蝗蟲是一種成群遷移的蚱蜢。
She added condensed milk to her tea.
她在茶裡加了煉乳。
This is a condensed version of the original report.
這是原始報告的精簡版。

sadistic.zh: 以折磨人為樂的；殘酷的
ai: The villain in the movie has a sadistic sense of humor.
電影裡的反派有一種殘酷的幽默感。
It was sadistic of him to enjoy watching others fail.
他以看別人失敗為樂，真是殘忍。

genteel.zh: 優雅有教養的；故作斯文的
ai: She grew up in a genteel family with fine manners.
她出身於一個舉止優雅的家庭。
The tea room had a quiet, genteel atmosphere.
那間茶室有種安靜而高雅的氣氛。
The storm last night was frightful.
昨晚的暴風雨真可怕。
We had a frightful time finding a parking space.
我們找停車位找得苦不堪言。
The meeting followed a predetermined schedule.
會議依照事先決定好的時程進行。
Fans felt the result of the match was predetermined.
球迷覺得比賽的結果是早就安排好的。
The window blinds are made of thin wooden slats.
這個百葉窗是用薄薄的木板條做成的。
One slat of the bed frame broke last night.
床架的其中一根板條昨晚斷了。

她說話時聲音裡壓抑著怒氣。

學生們在課堂上忍著笑了一聲。

我們用保冷瓶讓飲料保持冰涼。

這個家族以慈善事業聞名。

她成立了一個慈善團體來幫助當地學校。

reforming.zh: 改革；改造（reform 的現在分詞）
ai: The government is reforming the tax system.
政府正在改革稅制。

他正在改掉舊習慣，過更健康的生活。

沒有人能預言這個故事會如何結束。

那位老婦人聲稱她能預言天氣。

她帶著厭惡的神情看著那份壞掉的食物。

他對謊言深惡痛絕。

從一次不好的經驗就概括全部是不公平的。

科學家從許多實驗中歸納出一個規則。
The jury voted for acquittal after two days.
陪審團兩天後投票決定判他無罪。
His acquittal surprised many people in the town.
他獲判無罪讓鎮上許多人感到意外。
They moved to an apartment in uptown last year.
他們去年搬到上城區的一間公寓。
We took the subway uptown to see the museum.
我們搭地鐵到上城區去參觀博物館。
She works at an uptown restaurant.
她在一家位於上城區的餐廳工作。
The uptown streets are quiet in the evening.
上城區的街道在傍晚很安靜。

humanist.zh: 人文主義者；人道主義者
ai: The humanist argued that education should focus on human values.
那位人文主義者主張教育應該重視人的價值。
She is a humanist who believes in kindness without religion.
她是個人道主義者，相信不靠宗教也能待人良善。
She graciously accepted the invitation.
她欣然有禮地接受了邀請。
The host graciously welcomed every guest at the door.
主人在門口親切地迎接每一位客人。
The hotel charged us extra for breakfast.
飯店向我們額外收了早餐的錢。
The mechanic charged fifty dollars for the repair.
修理工收了五十元的修理費。
The man was charged with stealing a bike.
那個男人被控偷了一輛腳踏車。
Police charged him with speeding last night.
警方昨晚以超速罪名起訴他。

charged.zh: 氣氛緊張的；情緒激動的
ai: The room was charged with tension before the results came out.
結果公布前，房間裡瀰漫著緊張的氣氛。
It was an emotionally charged speech.
那是一場充滿情感的演說。

在漫長的戰爭期間開始實施糧食配給。
Water rationing started because of the drought.
因為乾旱，開始實施限水配給。
He saw an orthopaedic surgeon about his knee.
他為了膝蓋去看骨科醫生。
She sleeps on an orthopaedic mattress for her back.
她為了背部睡在矯形床墊上。
The nobleman lived in a huge castle.
那位貴族住在一座巨大的城堡裡。
In the story, a poor girl marries a young nobleman.
故事中，一個貧窮女孩嫁給了一位年輕貴族。
I packed beef jerky for the hiking trip.
我為登山之旅準備了牛肉乾。
This jerky is salty but very chewy.
這種肉乾很鹹，而且很有嚼勁。
The old bus made a jerky stop at the corner.
那輛舊公車在轉角處抖動著停了下來。
The video was jerky because the internet was slow.
因為網路很慢，影片一頓一頓的。
The judge was lenient with the young offender.
法官對這位年輕的犯人從輕發落。
Our coach is lenient about being a few minutes late.
我們教練對遲到幾分鐘很寬容。
Women are still underrepresented in some fields.
女性在某些領域的比例仍然偏低。
The program helps students from underrepresented communities.
這個計畫協助來自代表性不足社群的學生。
The colt stood up on shaky legs soon after birth.
小馬出生沒多久就用顫抖的腿站了起來。
The farmer trained the colt to wear a saddle.
農夫訓練那匹小公馬習慣戴馬鞍。
You can invite whomever you like to the party.
你可以邀請任何你想邀請的人來派對。
Give the prize to whomever the judges choose.
把獎品頒給評審選出的人。
The police found a forged passport in his bag.
警方在他的包包裡發現一本偽造的護照。
The painting turned out to be a forged copy.
那幅畫結果是偽造的仿作。
The blacksmith forged a sword from a single piece of iron.
鐵匠用一整塊鐵鍛造出一把劍。
The two countries forged a strong friendship over the years.
這兩個國家多年來建立起堅固的友誼。
The chef expertly sliced the fish.
主廚熟練地把魚切片。
She expertly steered the boat through the narrow channel.
她巧妙地駕船穿過狹窄的水道。
The guards stopped a breakout from the prison.
獄警阻止了一起越獄事件。
The army planned a breakout from the surrounded town.
軍隊計畫從被包圍的城鎮突圍。
Health workers warned of a breakout of flu in the school.
衛生人員警告學校內流感爆發。
The singer's breakout hit made her famous overnight.
這位歌手的成名曲讓她一夕爆紅。
He is an autistic child who loves trains.
他是個喜歡火車的自閉症孩子。
The school offers extra support for autistic students.
學校為自閉症學生提供額外的協助。
The wagon got stuck in a muddy slough.
馬車陷在泥濘的沼澤裡。
Frogs sang loudly from the slough at night.
夜裡青蛙在沼澤裡大聲鳴叫。
Snakes slough their skin several times a year.
蛇一年會蛻好幾次皮。
Dead skin cells slough off naturally.
死皮細胞會自然脫落。
Money is not always the best motivator.
金錢不一定是最好的動力來源。
Our coach is a great motivator for the team.
我們的教練很會激勵球隊。
The rocks by the river were slimy and hard to walk on.
河邊的石頭又濕又滑，很難走。
A slimy snail crawled across the path.
一隻黏滑的蝸牛爬過小徑。

slimy.zh: 油腔滑調的；令人反感的
ai: I don't trust that slimy salesman.
我不信任那個油腔滑調的業務員。
He gave a slimy smile and asked for a favor.
他露出討好的笑容，然後求我幫忙。
A grasshopper jumped onto the leaf.
一隻蚱蜢跳到葉子上。
The children caught a green grasshopper in the field.
孩子們在田野裡抓到一隻綠色的蚱蜢。
Some politicians pander to voters instead of telling the truth.
有些政客不說實話，只會迎合選民。
The show was criticized for pandering to young viewers.
這個節目因為一味迎合年輕觀眾而受到批評。

那對整間公司是一個影響重大的決定。
The court made a consequential ruling on privacy.
法院針對隱私權做出了意義重大的裁決。

consequential.zh: 隨之而來的；因而產生的
ai: The road closure and the consequential delays annoyed drivers.
道路封閉以及隨之而來的延誤讓駕駛人很不滿。
The company faced consequential losses after the fire.
火災之後，公司面臨隨之而來的損失。
He spoke with a strong sense of righteousness.
他說話時帶著強烈的正義感。
Many stories praise the righteousness of honest people.
許多故事讚美誠實之人的正直。
The old citadel stands on a hill above the town.
那座古老的堡壘矗立在城鎮上方的山丘上。
